notes_for_editor: Only the two FFLA Virginia lists were read. Two web searches found no news, agency or county record of the tower or its move. A search snippet mentioned an older Virginia listing with VDOF ownership and a removed status; it was not fetched and is not used. Distance of about 16 km between the Capron and Southampton points is computed from the listed coordinates. The Southampton Ag & Forestry Center's location and any access information remain unverified.
